owner: user ruling 2026-09-04 (width-void diagnosis) — classes are DATA: add a row + a fixture, never a code branch

declaration.root_override: data-page-root (optional: marks the page container when it is not <main>)
declaration.rail_marker: data-rail (optional: a fixed right column that COUNTS AS CONTENT, not chrome)

reference_viewports.source: ops/environment.md § Display & UI-build premise — 2560x1440 @150% maximised Chrome, external FHD; re-measure when the screen or scaling changes

unknown_policy.promotion_trigger: a page that shipped on an INFERRED class draws a second human layout report -> add the class row (with its fixture) and the page declares it; until then the gate may not FAIL what it cannot determine

defect_left_anchored_cap.definition: right void exceeds left void by more than `asymmetry_frac` of the content width — the page container (or a painted, row-alone block) is capped and hugs the left edge
defect_left_anchored_cap.block_promotion_trigger: the same block class (selector) reported by a human once after shipping -> FAIL for that selector via `block_fail_selectors`

defect_sibling_style_drift.definition: visible elements that share (tag, class list, declared aria-current/selected/pressed/expanded/checked state) and are not inside an <svg> render with different font-size / font-weight / font-family / line-height / letter-spacing: a class that names one component looks like two (PersonalSite 2026-10-31: four h2.section-title at 22/22/32/32 px because a contextual rule enlarged only two)
defect_sibling_style_drift.suppressed_and_counted: svg descendants (user units, per-node by design); a property whose values are equal in their RELATIVE reading (0.9em, unitless line-height meeting different parents); a property every element merely inherits from its parent. Each is counted in the finding block, none is dropped silently
defect_sibling_style_drift.promotion_trigger: the same class (selector) reported by a human once after shipping -> its selector prefix goes into `sibling_fail_selectors` and the drift becomes FAIL for that selector
defect_sibling_style_drift.added: 2026-10-31, user ruling (shared-layer bypass proposal, hole 3, C2)

defect_duplicate_rules.definition: two style rules under different selectors declare (nearly) the same declarations, read from the page's own CSSOM: a component declared twice under two names (PersonalSite 2026-10-31: .proj-thumb copied .story-thumb, .page-head .standfirst/.byline copied .prose ones). Concept from csscss ('X and Y share N rules', min-match threshold); csscss itself is not used (archived 2024, Ruby)
defect_duplicate_rules.channels: copy = >= min_shared identical declarations covering >= min_ratio of the shorter rule; same-target = the same class/id (final compound) styled in two contexts, which needs far less because sharing the name is itself most of the evidence
defect_duplicate_rules.not_reported: a pair that shares a selector, a pair whose selector names are equal (state or media variant of one component), a pair where one side's names contain the other's (contextual override)
defect_duplicate_rules.calibration: 2026-10-31, 33 human-facing pages / 24 distinct CSS families, see README 'In-page consistency': K=5 R=0.8 keeps the real PersonalSite thumb fork (shared 5 of 6 and 5 of 5; K=6 loses it, so the real positive sits on the edge) at 1.0 groups per CSS family (24 groups, 8 distinct forks, 6 judged real); K=4 R=0.6 is 5.4 per family, K=3 R=0.6 19.6
defect_duplicate_rules.promotion: none: WARN only, a fork is a code-structure judgment the gate cannot make for the author
defect_duplicate_rules.added: 2026-10-31, user ruling (shared-layer bypass proposal, hole 3, S3)

defect_clipped_overflow.definition: a display-formula block whose content is wider than its own box (scrollWidth - clientWidth > tolerance_px): the tail of the line, usually the boxed answer, sits behind a horizontal scroll or spills past the column — page reach cannot see it
defect_clipped_overflow.applies_to: every class (a property of the block, not of the page shape); advisory viewports downgrade it to WARN like every other finding
defect_clipped_overflow.added: 2026-10-13, fb row on tool:page-fill-gate — Silicon Photonics HW2/4/5 passed the gate while 17 calculation lines hid their answers at 1707 px; positive control = the pre-fix HW5-5 d0 line (1104/931 px)

document-short.zh: 短篇閱讀頁（報告、前後對照、owner-view）
document-short.notes: one centred column with symmetric margins; the reading measure is the point, so a wide viewport shows equal void on both sides (an 820px report column is 43% of 1920 — still a deliberate measure, hence the low floor)

dialog.zh: 單一置中對話框（解鎖、登入、確認）
dialog.notes: one card centred on an empty page; a fill floor is meaningless (the card is small by design), so only symmetry and the left-anchored defect rule (fb:86425480, 2026-10-13: document-short FAILed a login card on fill 30% at 1707)

document-long.zh: 長篇參考文件（教科書、案卷、討論包）
document-long.notes: fluid main column plus a right rail (data-rail) that carries figures / notes / registry cards; the rail counts as content

deck.notes: each slide is its own area; a text block may not sit narrower than the slide while alone in its row

tool.zh: 操作型 GUI（Chromium 開啟的 web tool、lobby 工具）
tool.notes: no page-level cap below the reference viewports; panels allocated proportionally (fr / % / cqw / minmax) and clamped in px only for intrinsic sizes; a cap above 1920px is a clamp, not a cap

diagram.zh: 圖為主載體（SVG 佔第一屏 ≥ 40%）
diagram.notes: the SVG scales to its container; a centred container with symmetric margins is fine, an off-centre one is not

dashboard.notes: auto-fit card grids; content sets row height, column count fills the width; a portal / launcher page (design-style-testbed T6 VIEWS, 5/5 PASS) is measured here

showcase.zh: 圖主展示頁（專案介紹、作品展示：滿版色帶＋置中內容，圖可出格）
showcase.notes: full-bleed painted bands without own text are backdrops and do not count as content (else every band page reads reach 100% and a left-capped column inside hides); content must be centred or reach >= 85% (a figure bleeding to the right edge reaches it); added 2026-10-02 with the figure-led page rule

content_classes.prose: read top to bottom; styling = AssetVault prose-doc-layer (rules/deliverable-doc-refs.md, prose bullet)
content_classes.node: scan and compare entities; a box per entity, colour per entity class (same rule, node bullet); NOT a presentation medium, outside references/design-axes
content_classes.figure-led: one claim + one evidence figure per unit (rules/deliverable-doc-refs.md figure-led page; decks add office-deck-deliverables P1-P5); cross-medium forms in references/design-axes
content_classes.diagram: the figure IS the page; representation chosen per diagram-authoring
